data.desc: Founded in 2006, Airship AI (NASDAQ: AISP) is a U.S. owned and operated technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. Airship AI builds AI software that turns the video, sensor and enterprise data organizations already collect into real-time operational intelligence and action for national security, public safety and commercial customers. The Airship AI platform runs at the edge, in the datacenter or in the cloud, and works on top of the cameras and systems customers already own. Airship AI's product suite includes Outpost AI edge hardware and software offerings, Fortress AI enterprise-scale analytics servers, Acropolis enterprise management software stack, Command family of visualization tools, and an emerging agentic AI software layer that lets users extract operational intelligence from existing video, sensor and enterprise data systems using natural language.
